title: Fresher Induction Week Registration Open
body: Welcome freshers to College of Engineering Karunagappally! Registration for the µLearn KNP induction bootcamps and Discord onboarding is now live. Complete your Level 1 tasks to earn your first 100 Karma points.

title: Call for Sub-Executive Committee Applications
body: Looking to take up leadership positions? Applications are open for Interest Group leads (Web, Cyber, AI/ML, Design) and Operations Leads for the 2026-27 term.

title: Weekly Learning Circle Schedule Announced
body: Learning Circles meet every Thursday at 4:30 PM. Group allocations for Web Dev and Cybersecurity have been posted on our official Discord server.
